texto: Six in ten American workers live paycheck to paycheck. And nearly half of the people earning six figures say the exact same thing.
This is not a story about low salaries. It is a story about money that is always in motion, quietly moving away from you.
Rent. Subscriptions. Payments. Upgrades. Every raise gets absorbed within about ninety days. Economists call it lifestyle creep. Banks call it business.
The exit is not earning more. It is the gap between what you earn and what you spend. That gap is the only number that matters.
